full_prompt_en: A square surreal architectural image is arranged around an exact central vertical axis. From the lower foreground, a pale stone plaza leads to a broad stair and then a narrow light-colored walkway that climbs toward the midpoint of the frame. Two tiny dark figures stand at different distances along this route, showing the immense scale of the setting. Balanced garden beds and rounded trees flank the steps, and long low walls repeat on the left and right. Above the horizon, a massive inverted structure descends from the top edge, its dark underside and planted surfaces narrowing to the same vanishing point as the path below. This impossible overhead mass creates an hourglass or X-shaped opening for a blue-gray sky. Puffy white clouds appear in mirrored banks on both sides, reinforcing the almost mechanical symmetry. The lower landscape is dark olive and muted green, while the central paved stripe is pale beige; the upper structure carries deep green-black texture. Daylight comes from the open sky, brightening the clouds and central walkway while leaving the trees and overhead underside in soft, heavy shade. The treatment resembles a carefully composited photograph: straight edges are crisp, foliage has fine grain, and atmospheric distance slightly softens the center. Repetition is precise without looking like a line drawing, and the small human silhouettes give the axis a measured pace. The whole frame feels monumental and disorienting, with a calm garden view held inside a strict mirrored perspective.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实建筑图像围绕精确的竖向中轴排列。从下方前景起，浅色石铺广场通向宽台阶，继而接上一条浅色窄步道，向画面中点上升。两个微小深色人物站在路线的不同距离处，显示环境的巨大尺度。对称花坛和圆形树木夹着台阶，左右两侧的低长墙相互重复。地平线上方，一座巨大的倒置结构从顶边垂下，深色底面和覆盖植物的表面收向与下方小路同一个消失点。这块不可能的头顶巨体为蓝灰天空留出沙漏或 X 形开口。蓬松白云在两侧形成镜像云带，强化几乎机械的对称。下方园景是深橄榄和柔暗绿色，中轴铺面为淡米色；上方结构带浓深绿黑肌理。日光来自开放天空，照亮云和中间步道，使树木与头顶底面留在柔和而沉重的阴影里。画法近似精细合成摄影：直线边缘清楚，植物有细颗粒，空气距离稍稍柔化中央。重复严密却不像线描，微小人物剪影让中轴有了可衡量的步调。整幅画面巨大而令人失去方向感，平静园景被固定在严整的镜像透视之内。
style_prompt_en: Surreal photographic compositing uses strict bilateral symmetry and a single deep vanishing point to make familiar surfaces feel monumental. Long pale linear planes converge between paired dark masses, while repeated organic textures soften the geometric order. An inverted upper weight presses toward a lower pathway, opening two balanced wedges of muted blue sky and luminous clouds. Crisp structural edges meet fine-grained greenery and gently softened distance. The restrained palette joins olive green, charcoal, stone beige, and cool sky blue. Daylight concentrates along the open central axis; shaded sides hold the composition in place. Small scale cues can emphasize the unusually large perspective without disturbing the measured, mirrored rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 超现实摄影合成利用严整的双侧对称和单一深远消失点，让熟悉的表面显得宏大。细长浅色平面在成对深暗体块之间聚拢，重复的有机肌理又软化几何秩序。倒置的上方重量压向下方通道，留出两块均衡的柔暗蓝天和发光云层。清晰结构边缘与细颗粒绿植、轻微柔化的远处相接。克制调色结合橄榄绿、炭灰、石米色和冷天空蓝。日光集中在开放的中轴，阴影两侧稳住构图。小尺度参照可强调异常巨大的透视，又不扰乱规整的镜像节奏。
theme_en: Two tiny visitors at the axis of a surreal mirrored garden passage
theme_zh: 两名微小访客位于超现实镜像花园通道的中轴线上
name: Symmetrical composition
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
